Intermediate progressive addition lenses (PALs) did not significantly affect ascent vertical toe clearance compared with distance single vision lenses (Wald χ2 = 0.4, p = 0.54), as reported in PMC4737269.

The effect of ES10/20 compared with R10 on low-density lipoprotein-particle number was numerically greater with ES10/20, but not statistically significant (−133.3 vs. −56.3 nmol/L; P>0.05). [PMC4845107]

intervention: weight management intervention targeting diet and physical activity plus usual care
text: The weight management intervention significantly increased fiber intake by 5.7 g/day at 12 months compared to usual care (p < .001), as reported in PMC4304200.

outcome: International Index of Erectile Function (IIEF-5)  in patients who showed no improvement of lower urinary tract symptoms (LUTS)
text: The effect of maintaining 0.2 mg/d tamsulosin versus increasing to 0.4 mg/d on IIEF-5 scores in patients with no LUTS improvement was not significant (p=0.859), according to [PMC3580298].

intervention: area-wide, computerised diabetes register incorporating a full structured recall and individualised patient management system
comparator: standard structured and recall management system
outcome: Frequency of at least one diabetes appointment, a foot check, receiving dietary advice, recording of blood pressure
text: The area-wide, computerised diabetes register significantly increased the frequency of diabetes appointments, foot checks, dietary advice, and blood pressure recording compared to the standard system (OR 2.00-2.77). Source: PMC1804280.
